patch_description: Add a gradient-based polish stage using scipy's SLSQP. After the heuristic void-filling/refine loop converges, treat the packing as a constrained optimization: maximize sum(r) subject to non-overlap constraints (r_i + r_j <= d_ij) and wall constraints (r_i <= min(x,y,1-x,1-y)). Starting from the already-feasible near-optimal configuration, SLSQP can make the fine-grained contact adjustments (aligning centers so circles touch tangentially in the hexagonal pattern) that the coarse nudge heuristic cannot reach. This directly targets the remaining gap toward AlphaEvolve's 2.635. Multiple restarts with a fallback ensure feasibility is preserved (we only accept improved feasible results).
